author: hmoens
name: lighttable_exposure_controls
description: lighttable_exposure_controls.lua adds lighttable buttons for bulk exposure adjustment (±1/3 EV, ±1 EV) and equalising exposure across a bracketed series.
description-extensive: This adds a row of buttons to darktable's lighttable view for quickly adjusting exposure on several selected photos at once, in steps of one-third and one full stop. It also includes an 'equalize exposure' button that matches a group of photos to the brightness of the first one you selected, using each shot's aperture, shutter speed, and ISO, which is handy for evening out bracketed or inconsistently exposed series. Because darktable can't edit these settings directly from the lighttable, it applies the changes quietly through temporary styles, so darktable must be set up to write XMP sidecar files.
